name: shieldprompt
description: Detects security vulnerabilities in AI-generated code the moment you paste it

commands.title: ShieldPrompt: Set AI Fix API key
ShieldPrompt: Clear AI Fix API key

shieldprompt.enabled.description: Enable or disable ShieldPrompt analysis on paste.

shieldprompt.minLines.description: Minimum number of lines in pasted text to trigger analysis.

shieldprompt.suppressedRules.description: List of rule IDs to suppress globally across the workspace.

shieldprompt.aiFixModel.description: Anthropic model used for AI Fix Suggestions.

shieldprompt.projectScanFileLimit.description: Maximum number of files scanned by the Scan Project command. Subsequent scans reuse a per-file mtime cache, so raising this is usually cheap.

shieldprompt.astLayer.description: Drop findings whose match position falls inside a comment or string literal (credential rules exempt). Reduces false positives where the matched pattern appears in an example string or explanatory comment rather than real code. Supported languages: JS/TS, Python. Set to false to get pre-1.1.2 behaviour.

shieldprompt.skipNoisyInTests.description: In test / fixture / mock files, drop behaviour findings (eval, SQL concat, etc.) but keep credential findings. Reduces noise from files that intentionally contain unsafe example code. Detected via path patterns: __tests__/, test/, spec/, fixtures/, *.test.*, *_test.py, conftest.py, etc.

shieldprompt.minSeverity.description: Minimum severity shown in the panel. 'warning' (default) shows everything. 'critical' hides warnings to reduce noise — credential leaks are always shown regardless.
